third-time-new-question.title: Third time, new question
third-time-new-question.script: Third time on this board, and this time the quarters replace the months. The question is not what happens any more, it is when you start.

the-arrow-points-at-q1.title: The arrow points at Q1
the-arrow-points-at-q1.script: The arrow points at Q1. If you want revenue in Q3, the first call happens in Q1, while there is still cash on the board.

four-steps.title: Four steps
four-steps.script: Four steps. Build your month-by-month cashflow view and find your zero-cash month. Start the lead list. Make the first contact. Track your deals, and measure conversion and cycle.

honest-caveat.title: Honest caveat
honest-caveat.script: The honest caveat: I cannot tell you your cycle length. It may be shorter, it may be longer, and that is why you measure it.

hand-over-the-verdict.title: Hand over the verdict
hand-over-the-verdict.script: So, when does your cash run out, and what did you do this week to move the money earlier? If the board helps, copy it, it is yours. Thank you.
